title: LLM-Guided Graph Generation for Structure-Based Local Improvement Methods
abstract: arXiv:2608.13333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large neighborhood search normally selects a random subset of decision variables for iterative optimization. For efficiently solving different problems, researchers tend to design variable selection strategies by taking into account structural features from different domains. In this paper, we build an automatic pipeline that is problem-agnostic to all problems in the MiniZinc format. By prompting an LLM with our semantic guidelines, we guide the LLM to produce a graph generator that maps any instance of a problem type to a uniform weighted graph, where nodes represent decision variables and edges represent constraint relationships. These problem-agnostic graphs guide our structure-based local improvement framework (SLIM) in variable selection. Meanwhile, the weighted graph enables all problem instances to share the same generic graph representation, from which the same graph features can be extracted and used for configuration selection

translated_title: 基于LLM引导的图生成用于结构导向的局部改进方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13333v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大邻域搜索通常随机选择决策变量的子集进行迭代优化。为了高效解决不同问题，研究者倾向于通过考虑不同领域的结构特征来设计变量选择策略。在本文中，我们构建了一个自动流水线，该流水线对MiniZinc格式中的所有问题都是问题无关的。通过使用我们的语义指南提示LLM，我们引导LLM生成一个图生成器，该生成器将任何问题类型的实例映射到一个均匀加权图，其中节点代表决策变量，边代表约束关系。这些问题无关的图指导我们的基于结构的局部改进框架（SLIM）进行变量选择。同时，加权图使所有问题实例能够共享相同的通用图表示，从中可以提取相同的图特征并用于配置选择。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用LLM自动生成问题无关的图表示来指导局部搜索中的变量选择，从而提升大邻域搜索效率的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method that uses LLM to automatically generate problem-agnostic graph representations to guide variable selection in local search, thereby improving the efficiency of large neighborhood search.
